When each task sits in a different system, even a simple recognition program creates recurring administrative work. Employees experience friction. Admins spend time coordinating. The program gradually becomes harder to maintain. Onboarding Onboarding takes too many steps Employee information is copied between spreadsheets, HR systems and recognition tools. EzRewards is designed to remove the operational friction between setting up a recognition program and keeping it active every day. Recognition should feel effortless to employees. Understand setup, seats, reward funding, employee access and administrative control. What is EzRewards? EzRewards gives employees a simple way to appreciate colleagues and gives administrators one place to manage users, rewards, seats and reporting. Is EzRewards only a gift-card platform? No. EzRewards connects peer recognition, the company feed, reward management, onboarding and reporting. Who is EzRewards designed for? Growing companies with 30 or more employees that want to run recognition without stitching together manual processes. Can any employee recognize another employee? Yes. Employees recognize colleagues across teams and departments without administrator approval. Does every recognition include a monetary reward? No. Recognition can remain completely non-monetary. Administrators assign rewards separately when needed. How does pricing work? EzRewards costs $1 per active employee each month. Pending invitations do not consume seats. What happens if we invite more employees than our current seat count? Only active users count. The subscription quantity increases automatically as more employees activate accounts. Is the reward budget included in the subscription? No. Platform fees and reward funding are separate. Your company manages the wallet independently. How do employees join? Administrators onboard employees through Microsoft SSO or structured CSV upload. What can administrators manage? Administrators can manage employee access, roles, active seats, the reward catalogue, reward assignments, wallet visibility and structured reports from EzRewards. Is EzRewards available now? EzRewards is accepting early-access applications. We contact applicants as onboarding slots become available. Give employees an easy way to appreciate. Give admins an easier way to run it. Launch recognition, manage rewards and review activity without adding another fragmented process. Join the Waitlist EzRewards — Recognition made easier to run.
